name: DataLabel
description: Represents the data label on a chart point or trendline.
remarks: In a series, the DataLabel object is a member of the DataLabels collection. The DataLabels collection contains a DataLabel object for each point. For a series without definable points (such as an area series), the DataLabels collection contains a single DataLabel object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns a String value that represents the name of the object.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the data label text.

properties.name: Characters
properties.description: Returns a Characters object that represents a range of characters within the object text. Use the Characters object to format characters within a text string.

properties.name: HorizontalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the horizontal alignment for the specified object.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of column A (on a worksheet) or the left edge of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the text orientation.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean value that determines if the object has a shadow.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Returns or sets the text for the specified object. Read/write String.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns or sets a Double value that represents the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top of row 1 (on a worksheet) or the top of the chart area (on a chart).

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the vertical alignment of the specified object.

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets the reading order for the specified object. Can be one of the following XlReadingOrder constants: xlRTL (right-to-left), xlLTR (left-to-right), or xlContext. Read/write Long.

properties.name: AutoText
properties.description: True if the object automatically generates appropriate text based on context. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets a String value that represents the format code for the object.

properties.name: NumberFormatLinked
properties.description: True if the number format is linked to the cells (so that the number format changes in the labels when it changes in the cells). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the format code for the object as a string in the language of the user.

properties.name: ShowLegendKey
properties.description: True if the data label legend key is visible. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlDataLabelPosition value that represents the position of the data label.

properties.name: ShowSeriesName
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean to indicate the series name display behavior for the data labels on a chart. True to show the series name. False to hide. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowCategoryName
properties.description: True to display the category name for the data labels on a chart. False to hide. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowValue
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean corresponding to a specified chart's data label values display behavior. True displays the values. False to hide. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowPercentage
properties.description: True to display the percentage value for the data labels on a chart. False to hide. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ShowBubbleSize
properties.description: True to show the bubble size for the data labels on a chart. False to hide. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Separator
properties.description: Sets or returns a Variant representing the separator used for the data labels on a chart. Read/write.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the ChartFormat object. Read-only.

properties.name: Formula
properties.description: Gets or sets a String value that represents the formula of the object using A1-style notation, in English. Read/write.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1
properties.description: Gets or sets a String value that represents the formula of the object using R1C1-style notation, in English. Read/write.

properties.name: FormulaLocal
properties.description: Gets or sets a String value that represents the formula of the object using A1-style notation, in the language of the user. Read/write.

properties.name: FormulaR1C1Local
properties.description: Gets or sets a String value that represents the formula of the object using R1C1-style notation, in the language of the user. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowRange
properties.description: Used to toggle the Range field if it exists on the data label range. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns the height of the object in points. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns the width of the object in points. Read-only.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.signature: SetProperty(ID As String, Value As Variant)
